notes.title: Meet Alejandro!
notes.content:
What would Freud think?

Alejandro is father of three members of our studio—Chavo, Augusto and me—so we've decided to model him in 3D. Now he's one of the four main characters of The Parrot That Summons Demons (and our pet actor!)

https://i.imgur.com/YzHT8KG.gif

I mean, The Parrot That Summons Demons can be described as a family tragedy/horror game, so what's better than including members of our actual family in our own game? 

Nothing can go wrong, right?

RIGHT?
